law.title: Following too closely (3)
law.text: Motor vehicles being driven upon any highway outside of a business district in a caravan or motorcade, whether or not towing other vehicles, shall be operated to allow sufficient space between each such vehicle or combination of vehicles so as to enable any other vehicle or combination of vehicles to enter and occupy such space without danger.

activation_conditions: two or more motor vehicles are driven in a caravan or motorcade
they are outside a business district
residue: tier S: 'sufficient space … without danger' is the whole obligation, so any gap value is a surrogate
'outside of a business district' is a legal region class — a reading assumption, never read from the scene
whether vehicles form a caravan (a shared purpose) is not observable; only a queue at a common speed is
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: the spacing is required throughout the caravan's travel
